attribution: River centrelines: India-WRIS's river network, republished as a PMTiles archive by indian_water_features and read at zoom 10. Every feature carries its river's name and basin, so a named river joins by name -- and by name in its basin where there are namesakes. The network item on the country tier is every other river WRIS counts as major; a lifted state adds every river in it at least 40 km long. Facts checked against India-WRIS and Wikipedia.
_rank: 1 is a great river drawn widest, 3 a tributary drawn finest; the engine reads rank, never a river's name.

note.en: India's rivers as the government's water survey draws them: the 28 told here by name over every other river it counts as major, 47,000 km of it. Open a state and every river inside it at least 40 km long joins them, at five times the detail. The flow runs downstream, found from the relief.
note.hi: भारत की नदियाँ, जैसे सरकार का जल सर्वेक्षण उन्हें खींचता है: यहाँ नाम सहित कही गई 28 नदियाँ, उन सब प्रमुख नदियों के ऊपर जिन्हें वह गिनता है — कुल 47,000 किमी। किसी राज्य को खोलें, तो उसके भीतर की हर 40 किमी से लंबी नदी इनसे आ मिलती है, पाँच गुना बारीकी से। प्रवाह नीचे की ओर चलता है, जो उभार से जाना गया है।
